title: pace-codes-e-and-f-2018.pdf — section 34
text:
4.10 If there is an equipment failure which can be rectified quickly, e.g. by commencing a new
secure digital network recording using the same device or a replacement device, the
interviewer shall follow the appropriate procedures as in paragraphs 4.7 to 4.9 (Taking a
break during interview). When the recording is resumed, the interviewer shall explain what
happened and record the time the interview recommences. However, if it is not possible to
continue recording on the same device or by using a replacement device, the interview
should be audio- recorded on removable media as in paragraph 3.3, if the necessary
equipment is available. If it is not available, the interview may continue and be recorded in
writing in accordance with paragraph 2.3 as directed by the ‘relevant officer’. (See Note
3H.)
(G) Conclusion of interview
